summary: Refined phi-pop walk motion to introduce hunched stalking staging, squared sine swing lifts for smooth foot/limb liftoff, weight-derived torso sway, and readable head/arm overlap without altering root motion or clip duration.
expectedEffect: Brings character silhouette and weight distribution closer to stylized fantasy guidelines, reducing linear snapping and improving leg/support readability at game camera distance.
